_description: Field offset overrides for structs where TAUDT_FIXED cannot create the struct (too large, too sparse).
_notes: These offsets have binary evidence from function analysis.
Codegen emits inline comments (/* fieldName */) after raw offset expressions.
Does NOT use TAUDT_FIXED - bypasses IDA struct creation limits.
Not a substitute for proper struct annotation - use when IDA can't create the struct.
